profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience in microservices development using Java and Kotlin. I specialize in creating efficient and scalable solutions. My journey into the world of software engineering began with a Bachelor's degree in Aerospace Engineering, followed by a Master's degree in Industrial Mathematics. 
I am a team player, a problem solver, and a lifelong learner, who strives to deliver high-quality products that meet the needs of the users and the business.
Right now, I'm on the lookout for challenging roles in New York City, where I can contribute to cutting-edge software projects.
